item.title: Survey: Romanians are closer to “traditional” values, less aware of gender discrimination
item.description: Romanians have limited perceptions of gender inequalities and continue to maintain traditional views on the roles of women and men, according to Eurostat data from the survey on the perception of gender stereotypes, processed by Social Monitor, a project of the Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Romania. item.title: Bucharest in danger of payment default if the state budget is not adopted next week, mayor says
item.description: Bucharest mayor Ciprian Ciucu called on coalition parties to adopt the state budget next week in the form proposed by the government during a statement made on Friday, March 6. Otherwise, Bucharest risks entering into payment default. item.title: Ambulance for Monuments plans works on 17 historical monuments in Romania this year
item.description: The Ambulance for Monuments, a project initiated by the non-profit Monumentum Association, plans to work on safeguarding 17 historical monuments across the country this year, according to a calendar released at the beginning of March. This year’s interventions cover areas such as southern Transylvania, Banat, Sălaj, Bihor, Arad, Bistrița-Năsăud, western Oltenia, northern Muntenia, northern Moldova, and Dobrogea, according to Agerpres. item.title: Romania activates rescEU mechanism, repatriates 273 citizens amid Middle East security crisis
item.description: Two evacuation flights carrying Romanian citizens affected by the security crisis in the Middle East landed in Bucharest on Monday, March 9, bringing home 273 Romanians, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAE) announced. The repatriations were carried out through the European Union’s rescEU mechanism, which Romania requested to activate for evacuations. item.title: Romania and Moldova to plant joint forest along Prut River, minister says
item.description: Romania will begin its annual tree-planting season alongside a new environmental initiative with the Republic of Moldova, environment minister Diana Buzoianu announced. The joint effort will include the planting of a shared forest along both banks of the Prut River at the Sculeni border crossing. The campaign coincides with Romania’s “Luna Pădurii” (Forest Month), the period when forestry workers across the country launch nationwide afforestation activities. item.title: Romania’s Ombudsman refers government’s public administration bill to Constitutional Court
item.description: Romania’s Ombudsman Renate Weber has referred to the Constitutional Court the emergency government ordinance that rationalises the personnel expenditures in the public administration, according to Economica.net. The bill is part of the second package of six budgetary measures and a key element of the 2026 budget plan. item.title: Romania revises slightly upwards 2025 GDP growth to 0.7%
item.description: Romania’s statistics office INS confirmed the economic slowdown in 2025, revising the annual growth rate marginally to 0.7% from 0.6% under the flash estimate, according to preliminary data published on March 6. The growth episodes were concentrated in Q3 (+1.7% y/y), after the political stabilisation in July, judging from the methodology used by the national statistics, or in Q2-Q3 (+2.5% y/y and +1.3% y/y respectively) under the chain-linked methodology used by Eurostat. item.title: Romania’s state-controlled Electrica seeks EUR 1 bln bond issue
item.description: State-controlled utility group Electrica (BVB: EL) on March 6 announced that it will seek shareholder approval for a green bond issue worth one billion euros (denominated in euros or other currency) during the period 2026-2027, according to a company note to investors. item.title: Raiffeisen reportedly close to taking over Garanti Bank Romania
item.description: Raiffeisen Bank is close to acquiring Garanti BBVA Romania from Spanish banking group BBVA, according to sources cited by Profit.ro. The Austrian lender’s offer is currently preferred by the seller and may be designated the winning bid if the deal is finalised and receives approval from Romania’s central bank and competition authority.
